_comment: PROPOSAL for the maintainer to review: scope for the statewide Open Food Web homepage, modeled on exports/chaffee-provides.config.json. Not yet approved. Build with --statewide --unconfirmed-home-pins hide: without 'hide', producers whose sales channels are not confirmed would get a home-base pin, which for many small producers is a private home.

exclude_kinds.bakery: Proposal: the homepage is about growers and makers; bakeries stay out until the maintainer decides (as on Chaffee Provides)

exclude_categories.Agritourism: Proposal: not a way to buy food; matches the Chaffee Provides scope
exclude_categories.Bakery: Proposal: not part of the farms/ranches/orchards/makers/wineries scope
exclude_categories.Restaurant: Proposal: dining outlets are not exported (kinds are not in include_outlet_kinds)
exclude_categories.Caterer: Proposal: dining outlets are not exported (kinds are not in include_outlet_kinds)
